quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the Knicks' defensive lapses against the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: We just lost discipline there for for a couple of positions and that that gave them life.
quotes.quote: It happened. We had three, four straight positions that we did not execute our coverages what they're supposed to do. That was a totally cold game. We just lost discipline there for for a couple of positions and that that gave them life. I thought we had a game under control. We did a really good job defensively for the biggest part of the game, but that little stretch there gave them gave them life.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on the experience of being traded
quotes.excerpt: A lot of guys hit me personally, just sharing advice, sharing their personal experiences with being traded.

text_blocks.speaker: Gradey Dick
text_blocks.text: Of course. I mean, we have a team group chat. A lot of guys hit me personally, just sharing advice, sharing their personal experiences with being traded. It'd be my first time and stuff like that. So, just my brothers at the end of the day and yeah, we're not on the same team anymore, but I mean, it's all love and they know that too and they know that this is a business, but at the same time, it's basketball we've all been playing for many years and at the end of the day, we're going to be friends.

text_blocks.text: GD, it's your boy, the vet man, just shouting out, hope you liking the sun out there in LA. I'm here for you if you got it if you needing anything. You know what I'm saying? I'm happy for for what you're doing out there. Continue to play hard, do your thing, brother. I'm always here for you.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on maintaining authenticity on social media
quotes.excerpt: The main word is just authenticity. To me, it's just being me.
quotes.quote: The main word is just authenticity. To me, it's just being me. And I think kind of the cringiest thing that I see is when you can kind of tell it's fake. People are kind of putting on a mask. I mean, at the end of the day, they do them. I don't care, but at the same time, it's it's pretty obvious, you know? So I feel like just being myself and sometimes I just imagine if I post something, my friends are going to see it and if they think it's funny, then I'm definitely going to think it's funny.
